action_args.justification: The series is strongly trend-dominated (trend strength 0.913) with weak seasonality (0.27) and unstable model ranking (Kendall tau 0.103). A robust median over a 5-model pool that spans the top error-correlation groups (ETS/THETA, DWT_catboost, CWT variants) avoids chasing window-specific noise while retaining complementary error structure. The leader's margin over the runner-up is statistically indistinguishable (0.0031), and all full-pool or fitted-weight strategies score materially worse, confirming that robustness on a small diverse pool is the right regime for this series.
